subject: [hw] DONE V10 rev 2
body:
V10 rev 2 (no review findings yet; numbers refreshed after extending the test set).

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V10 PASS 220589/220589

What changed since rev 1 (test-only, implementation unchanged):
- 542 unit cases (was 492): added r15-as-ALU-operand cases (`add r0,r1,pc`, `add r0,pc,r1`)
  and register-shift cases ROR by 32 (amount mod 32 == 0), LSL by 33 and LSR by 33 (the
  greater-than-32 paths for every shift type). All 16 ALU mnemonics now have 7 immediate +
  10 immediate-shift + 9 register-shift cases, plus the r15 cases.
- Not-done list unchanged: T01 differential kernels are written and now installed by T01 as
  tests/emu/kernels/k10_v10_dp.c, but emu/n2a32_core.c still has the old a32_route case 0
  (`hi >= 8 && bit24` -> arm_mem), which sends ORR/MOV/BIC/MVN and register-shifted ALU to the
  wrong class; the official run_diff.sh is red until V02 applies the consolidated patch. In my
  /tmp copy with that patch, all k_v10_* calls pass in arm-O0/O2/O3v and armv8-O3v with zero
  mismatches; thumb configs stop on T32 32-bit code (V15/V16 not in the tree).
- D01 census still absent; acceptance check pending.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_dp.c (unchanged since rev 1), gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v10/**
(encodings.txt, cases_v10.inc, undef_v10.inc, gen_cases.py, STATUS.md updated),
gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V10/STATUS.md.
